newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles at record following placing.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles at record following placing.

text.p: Shares in Biocompatibles International Plc touched a record high in early trade on Thursday as investors scrambled for shares having failed to secure all the stock they wanted in Wednesday's placing, dealers said.
"Having held off for the placing, a lot of people didn't get all the stock they wanted and they are now having to pay up for the stock they want," said a senior dealer at one top securities house.
The stock was up 42-1/2p at 14.02-1/2 by 0747 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 14.40 stg -- surpassing the previous peak of 14.35 stg set April 11.

Biocompatibles, a maker of medical devices, said yesterday its brokers Merrill Lynch and Kleinwort Benson placed five million shares at 13.35 stg per share, included 1.5 million held by Johnson & Johnson Development Corporation.
The stock has almost tripled in value in the past five months amid positive news on the company's materials technology, applied in contact lenses and "stents" used in heart surgery.
Earlier this month, Biocompatibles recieved regulatory approval to market its contact lens product in the United States.
